entries.title: Genesis 25:1
segments: ¶And Abraham took another wife named Keturah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:2
segments: She became the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:3
segments: And Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan. And from Dedan came the Asshurim and Letushim and Leummim.

entries.title: Genesis 25:4
segments: And from Midian came Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the offspring of Keturah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:5
segments: Now Abraham gave all his property to Isaac;

entries.title: Genesis 25:6
segments: But to the sons of his other women he gave offerings, and sent them away, while he was still living, into the east country.

entries.title: Genesis 25:7
segments: Now the years of Abraham's life were a hundred and seventy-five.

entries.title: Genesis 25:8
segments: And Abraham came to his death, an old man, full of years; and he was put to rest with his people.

entries.title: Genesis 25:9
segments: And Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, put him to rest in the hollow rock of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, near Mamre;

entries.title: Genesis 25:10
segments: The same field which Abraham got from the children of Heth: there Abraham was put to rest with Sarah, his wife.

entries.title: Genesis 25:11
segments: ¶Now after the death of Abraham, the blessing of God was with Isaac, his son.

entries.title: Genesis 25:12
segments: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, the son of Abraham, whose mother was Hagar the Egyptian, the servant of Sarah:

entries.title: Genesis 25:13
segments: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael by their generations: Ishmael's first son was Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam

entries.title: Genesis 25:14
segments: And Mishma and Dumah and Massa,

entries.title: Genesis 25:15
segments: Hadad and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:

entries.title: Genesis 25:16
segments: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names in their towns and their tent-circles; twelve chiefs with their peoples.

entries.title: Genesis 25:17
segments: And the years of Ishmael's life were a hundred and thirty-seven: and he came to his end, and was put to rest with his people.

entries.title: Genesis 25:18
segments: And their country was from Havilah to Shur which is east of Egypt: they took their place to the east of all their brothers.

entries.title: Genesis 25:19
segments: ¶Now these are the generations of Abraham's son Isaac:

entries.title: Genesis 25:20
segments: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramaean of Paddan-aram, and the sister of Laban the Aramaean, to be his wife.

entries.title: Genesis 25:21
segments: Isaac made prayer to the Lord for his wife because she had no children; and the Lord gave ear to his prayer, and Rebekah became with child.

entries.title: Genesis 25:22
segments: And the children were fighting together inside her, and she said, If it is to be so, why am I like this? So she went to put her question to the Lord.

entries.title: Genesis 25:23
segments: And the Lord said to her, Two nations are in your body, and two peoples will come to birth from you: the one will be stronger than the other, and the older will be the servant of the younger.

entries.title: Genesis 25:24
segments: And when the time came for her to give birth, there were two children in her body.

entries.title: Genesis 25:25
segments: And the first came out red from head to foot like a robe of hair, and they gave him the name of Esau.

entries.title: Genesis 25:26
segments: And after him, his brother came out, gripping Esau's foot; and he was named Jacob: Isaac was sixty years old when she gave birth to them.

entries.title: Genesis 25:27
segments: And the boys came to full growth; and Esau became a man of the open country, an expert bowman; but Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

entries.title: Genesis 25:28
segments: Now Isaac's love was for Esau, because Esau's meat was greatly to his taste: but Rebekah had more love for Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 25:29
segments: ¶And one day Jacob was cooking some soup when Esau came in from the fields in great need of food;

entries.title: Genesis 25:30
segments: And Esau said to Jacob, Give me a full meal of that red soup, for I am overcome with need for food: for this reason he was named Edom.

entries.title: Genesis 25:31
segments: And Jacob said, First of all give me your birthright.

entries.title: Genesis 25:32
segments: And Esau said, Truly, I am at the point of death: what profit is the birthright to me?

entries.title: Genesis 25:33
segments: And Jacob said, First of all give me your oath; and he gave him his oath, handing over his birthright to Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 25:34
segments: Then Jacob gave him bread and soup; and he took food and drink and went away, caring little for his birthright.
